title: delissea pilosa
intro: Delissea pilosa, commonly known as the hairy delissea, is a flowering plant species in the heath family (Ericaceae). It is native to Hawaii and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Delissea pilosa include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, that work to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant properties.
